verdict.rationale: Mercury's site directly claims that AI reads bills, fills in payment details automatically, and remembers past recipients so the user can approve and pay in seconds. That covers reading, auto-populating and reviewing. Documented approval controls for payments reinforce the review step. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the bill-pay AI (how bills are ingested, which fields are extracted, accuracy and correction flow), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the feature works as claimed.
